paragraphs: Rav Natan. The exilarch came to his house in Hagrunya. Rafram and all the rabbis came to the exposition; Ravina did not. Next day Rafram wished to remove Ravina from the exilarch's displeasure, asking why he had not come, etc. Ravina answered, 'Does the master not hold,' etc., Yoma 78a. R. Shemuel bar Abba said: R. Yoḥanan said; Rav Natan objects, etc.; Rava said, Nazir 51a. Rav Yehudah and Rav Natan, one says, beginning of Mashilin.
